versions.subject: Improved MSHTA rule
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 1
    ParentImage:
        - '*\mshta.exe'
    Image:
        - '*\cmd.exe'
        - '*\powershell.exe'
        - '*\wscript.exe'
        - '*\cscript.exe'
        - '*\sh.exe'
        - '*\bash.exe'
        - '*\reg.exe'
        - '*\regsvr32.exe'
        - '*\BITSADMIN*'
filter:
    Commandline:
        - '*/HP/HP*'
        - '*\HP\HP*'
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: EventID=1 ParentImage="*\\mshta.exe" Image IN ("*\\cmd.exe", "*\\powershell.exe", "*\\wscript.exe", "*\\cscript.exe", "*\\sh.exe", "*\\bash.exe", "*\\reg.exe", "*\\regsvr32.exe", "*\\BITSADMIN*") NOT (Commandline IN ("*/HP/HP*", "*\\HP\\HP*"))
